report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0012, p95 78ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Only a single ERROR trace shows gateway->order at 1909ms, and no order-side telemetry was provided. Current evidence cannot establish a bounded root cause; order/payment/inventory/postgres/redis telemetry is required.
missing_evidence: Order service traces, metrics, and logs for the same window to explain the 1909ms ERROR span
Payment, inventory, postgresql, and redis dependency latency/error telemetry
Gateway error-rate and latency time series to confirm alert magnitude and onset
Deployment records for gateway/order in the incident window
